description: This file defines the core models and functions for the RetinaNet object detection architecture, including submodels for classification and regression, feature pyramid creation, anchor generation, and the assembly of the complete RetinaNet model with optional bounding box prediction layers.

methods.name: default_classification_model
methods.description: Creates a Keras model for classifying anchors at each feature level, with configurable number of classes, anchors, and feature sizes.

methods.name: default_regression_model
methods.description: Creates a Keras model for regressing bounding box coordinates for anchors, with configurable number of values, anchors, and feature sizes.

methods.name: __create_pyramid_features
methods.description: Constructs the feature pyramid layers (P3-P7, optionally P2) on top of backbone features for use in detection.

methods.name: default_submodels
methods.description: Returns the default set of submodels (regression and classification) used in RetinaNet.

methods.name: retinanet
methods.description: Builds the full RetinaNet model with feature pyramid, anchor generation, and submodels for classification and regression.

methods.name: retinanet_bbox
methods.description: Wraps the RetinaNet model to produce bounding box predictions with NMS and filtering, suitable for inference.
